== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Rectenna (PC Errata 2017 slip)]]. Compared with [[Rectenna (PC Errata 2013 slip)]]. The earlier slip and the new slip, both as cut from their sheets at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited. (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
